title: Variants of Content
note: Despite its book title, this table is really the master case-by-case fact table: one row per case of rise of thought (234 total), each row a set of foreign keys into the other dimension tables. 'nomenclature_id' -> table-iii.json (T), 'sphere_id' -> table-iv.json (S), 'content_ids' -> table-v-content.json (C, an ordered array of ids -- a case's full content is the composition of every listed id in order; null where the case has no content of its own -- lettered subvariants and closing/attainment clauses (linked to their base id via table-v-content.json's parent_id) appear here simply as further ids in the array, e.g. case 9's content_ids is ["1", "1a", "1b", "1c", "1d", "0(1)"] -- no special-cased subvariant/closing/also/recombination fields, everything the case's content comprises is just listed in order), 'trancic_id' -> table-v-trancic.json (TV; null where not applicable, otherwise an id or array of ids -- a case can carry more than one, e.g. a paṭipada id plus an abhiññā id), 'object_ids' -> table-v-objects.json (O; a sense-object range like "1-6" or a bracketed dhyanic-object code like "[1]"; null where the case has no object at all, e.g. the plain kāmāvacara-citta cases 111/111a/111b), 'sphere_gloss' -- present only where the source gives fresh Table V text for the Sphere of Thought column rather than 'do.' (sphere_id is the FK either way; the gloss is supplementary, e.g. distinguishing 11 synonym-phrasings of the lokuttara path across cases 138/138a-138k that all share sphere_id 4), 'mental_ids' -> table-v-mental.json (MV; an array of ids, empty where none apply). Each dimension table is populated incrementally as later pages are transcribed -- ids referenced here but not yet defined in a dimension file will be filled in later. case_id is a string for cases with a letter suffix (e.g. "45a"), a number otherwise. Case 13 does not exist -- the book's own numbering jumps from 12 to 14.
